card.name: Start of the word Pulmonary
card.fires_on: The first piece "Pul" of the word pulmonary, when it starts a section heading or a condition name in drug label text. It often follows a section number like 5.5 or the phrase "Patients with".

modes.label: Section headings
modes.description: "Pul" begins a numbered warnings heading such as Pulmonary Toxicity or Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension.

modes.label: Condition after a phrase
modes.description: "Pul" begins a lung condition after "Patients with" or "Chronic".

card.writes: It suppresses clinical and symptom words, so it adds little clear output beyond a weak push away from these terms.
card.plain: It marks the start of the word pulmonary in lung-related headings and conditions on drug labels.
